PeterCHayward:

Strike Three: Mr. Fixer deals himself up to three damage. Deal X targets 1 damage, where X is the amount of damage Mr. Fixer dealt himself.

 

Wow.  That would make Dual Crowbars insane.  Have Fixer deal himself 3 damage (bumped to 4 thanks to Crowbars), deal 5 damage to a target.  Then deal 2 damage to a target, deal 3 damage to another target, and repeat three more times.  Basically, deal himself 4 damage to spread 25 damage among enemy targets, as long as there are three or more enemies in play.  This would let him easily clear mob-heavy decks like Voss, Matriarch, Dreamer, and Final Wasteland.  Also would make him pretty dominating in Vengeance/Villains style play.  Add a Greased Monkey Fist or other damage boost and he gets even more crazy.  Interestingly, it does not break Jack Handle as much, since he doesn't actually hit himself, so he only gets one shot of damage off; though it does let him deal 3 damage to everything for free, which is still kinda ridiculous.

 

I'm okay with this.
